newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SPT says calls through Germany cut.
newsitem.headline: Czech SPT says calls through Germany cut.

text.p: The Czech telephone company SPT Telecom a.s. said on Tuesday that some of its international connections through Germany were cut early in the morning due to a cable disruption on German territory.

In a statement, SPT said that calls passing through Germany to such destinations as London, Zurich, Geneva, Seville, Tunis, Algiers, Lisbon, Montreal and Amsterdam were affected and that the German telephone company Deutsche Telekom AG was working on repairing the breakdown.
SPT apologised for the inconvenience and asked for understanding from its customers.
Last Thursday a similar problem caused calls through Germany to be disrupted for several hours.
